title: Conflicting Legitimate Authority Observations
purpose: Determine how the existing V04 execution boundary behaves when two type-correct authority observations from the same legitimate lineage disagree about present standing.

adversarial_condition.observation_a: ACTIVE authority with SEND at epoch N
adversarial_condition.relationship: Both observations derive from the same AuthorityState lineage.
adversarial_condition.uncertainty: The resolver cannot truthfully establish one observation as the single current authoritative state.

questions: Can the current authority-resolution interface represent legitimate conflicting observations as a first-class governance state?
If conflict cannot be represented natively, how does the existing execution boundary classify it?
prohibited_interpretation: A refusal alone must not be represented as proof that V04 understands split-brain authority.
A non-AuthorityState rejection must be distinguished from native conflict representation.
